games.helpBody:
Enable Games for your profile, keep Sunshine or another compatible host running, then choose a discovered computer. Approve the first connection and choose a game. Pairing authorization belongs to this device; the saved library belongs to this PlezyNG profile.

The Android engine is bundled into PlezyNG and includes touch controls and gamepad support. Other native platforms and Steam playback are still being implemented. Steam discovery does not mean playback is available.

Sunshine, Apollo, Wolf and older GameStream hosts can expose different features. Pairing requires the host’s approval. QR codes open the Sunshine PIN page; they do not carry your credentials.

For access away from home, use the computer’s VPN address. Automatic discovery normally stays on the local network.

Leaving a stream keeps the game running on the computer. Stop it from the stream menu when you want to end the host session.
games.manualHint: For Moonlight use the host’s GameStream HTTP port (usually 47989), not its web settings port. Steam normally advertises on 27036.

games.steamEnginePending: Steam computers can be discovered and saved. Embedded Steam pairing and playback are still in development, including the Pyrowave beta codec.
games.steamBetaDescription: Pyrowave support is planned for the embedded Steam engine. Discovery alone cannot tell whether a computer or this device can use it. Playback remains unavailable until the engine has been integrated and tested.
